product_name: Lava Blaze Duo 3 5G (Moonlight Black, 6GB RAM, 128GB Storage) | MTK D7060 Processor | 6.67" FHD+ AMOLED Display | 50MP AI Camera with 2K Video Recording | Dual Screen AMOLED Display
description: Brilliant Dual-Display Experience: 6.67" FHD+ AMOLED main screen with up to 1000 nits brightness, plus a 1.6" rear display for quick notifications, selfies, and always-on convenience. Powerful Performance: MediaTek Dimensity 7060 chipset paired with 6GB LPDDR5 RAM and 128GB UFS 3.1 storage for ultra-smooth multitasking and fast app loading. 50MP Sony Camera System: Capture stunning detail with the Sony IMX752 sensor, f/1.8 aperture, and 2K video recording—plus a handy rear display for perfect selfies. Long-Lasting 5000mAh Battery: All-day power with 33W fast charging, stereo speakers, in-display fingerprint, and IR Blaster for added convenience. Premium, Durable Design: Sleek 7.55mm body, lightweight 181g build, 5G connectivity, Bluetooth 5.2, and IP64 certification for dust and splash resistance.
